mapper.select:
SELECT M.MENU_CODE, M.MENU_NAME, M.PARENT_CODE, M.SYSTEM_TYPE,
-- 사용자 권한 MAX(CASE WHEN A.ACTION_CODE = 'READ' THEN A.AUTH_YN END) AS readAuth, MAX(CASE WHEN A.ACTION_CODE = 'CREATE' THEN A.AUTH_YN END) AS createAuth, MAX(CASE WHEN A.ACTION_CODE = 'UPDATE' THEN A.AUTH_YN END) AS updateAuth, MAX(CASE WHEN A.ACTION_CODE = 'DELETE' THEN A.AUTH_YN END) AS deleteAuth
FROM TB_MENU_MASTER M LEFT JOIN TB_USER_MENU_AUTH A ON M.COMPANY_CODE = A.COMPANY_CODE AND M.MENU_CODE = A.MENU_CODE AND A.USER_ID = #{userId}
WHERE M.COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} ORDER BY M.SORT_ORDER
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_USER_MENU_AUTH ( COMPANY_CODE, USER_ID, MENU_CODE, ACTION_CODE, AUTH_YN ) VALUES ( #{companyCode}, #{userId}, #{menuCode}, #{actionCode}, #{authYn} )
mapper.select: SELECT MENU_CODE, ACTION_CODE, AUTH_YN FROM TB_USER_MENU_AUTH WHERE COMPANY_CODE = #{companyCode} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
